data.one_liner: Unified widget to display any image source (asset, network, file, SVG, base64, bytes, icon) across platforms.
data.what_it_does: UniversalImage abstracts over different image types and providers, handling format detection, caching and rendering. It integrates flutter_svg for SVGs and extended_image for caching and advanced features.
use_when: You need a single widget to handle multiple image sources without manual type checks
Cross‑platform apps (mobile, web, desktop) require consistent image handling
You want built‑in caching and optional SVG support
avoid_when: You only need simple network images and prefer a lightweight solution
Fine‑grained control over caching policies is required beyond what extended_image offers
strengths: Supports many formats (JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, SVG, base64, bytes, icons)
Works on all Flutter platforms including web WASM
Leverages extended_image caching and flutter_svg rendering
Simple API – just pass the source
weaknesses: Adds extra dependencies (flutter_svg, extended_image) increasing bundle size
Limited customization compared to using extended_image directly
Documentation is limited to basic examples

alternatives.name: cached_network_image
alternatives.why_pick_it: Lightweight network image caching without SVG or other source support

alternatives.name: flutter_svg
alternatives.why_pick_it: Only need SVG rendering without the extra universal wrapper

alternatives.name: image
alternatives.why_pick_it: Low‑level image manipulation when you don't need a widget wrapper
